explanation:
$\mathrm{A}_2+\mathrm{B}_2 \rightleftharpoons 2 \mathrm{AB}$

এখানে, $\Delta n=2-2=0$

আমরা জানি,

$K_p=K_c(R T)^{\Delta n}$

$\begin{aligned} \text { বা, } \mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{p}} & =\mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{c}}(\mathrm{RT})^{\circ} \\ \text { বা, } \mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{p}} & =\mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{c}} \\ \therefore \mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{p}}=5.6 \text { হলে, } \mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{c}} & =5.6 \text { । }\end{aligned}$
